info.name: RideApp — Complete Ride Lifecycle
info.description:
Full end-to-end ride flow extracted directly from your controllers.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
COMPLETE FLOW A — BIDDING MODE (most common)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════
Step 1:  Rider registers + logs in
Step 2:  Driver registers + logs in + KYC + toggles ONLINE
Step 3:  Rider creates ride request (pricingMode: bidding)
Step 4:  Driver sees nearby pending requests
Step 5:  Driver submits bid (expires in 15 min from your code)
Step 6:  Rider sees all bids with driver stats (safety score, rating, rides)
Step 7:  Rider accepts bid → ride created + socket:bid:accepted fires
         → RidePaymentService.authorizeRidePayment auto-called (funds in escrow)
Step 8:  Driver gets ride details (stops, rider info, vehicle)
Step 9:  Driver starts ride → socket:ride:started fires to rider
Step 10: [Optional] Arrive at stop → depart from stop (for multi-stop rides)
Step 11: Driver completes ride → socket:ride:completed fires
         → RidePaymentService.completeRidePayment auto-called (escrow → driver + platform)
Step 12: Review submitted

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
COMPLETE FLOW B — FIXED PRICE MODE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════
Step 1-3: Same as above but pricingMode: fixed_price
Step 4:   Driver calls POST /api/rides/accept/:requestId directly (no bidding)
          → Skips bidding entirely, ride created immediately
Step 5-12: Same as bidding flow

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
CANCELLATION FLOWS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════
A. Cancel ride REQUEST (before accepted): PUT /api/ride-requests/:id/cancel
B. Cancel active RIDE (after accepted/started): POST /api/rides/:id/cancel
   → Triggers RidePaymentService.cancelRidePayment (refund escrow → rider)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
KEY CODE NOTES FROM YOUR CONTROLLERS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════
• Fare calc: Haversine formula, Rs.20/km, ±10% buffer (fareMin/fareMax)
• Bids expire: 15 minutes from submission (expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '15 min')
• Bids sorted: lowest bid_amount first, then oldest
• acceptRideRequest checks: DRIVER_ALREADY_ON_ACTIVE_RIDE (409)
• acceptRideRequest checks: REQUEST_ALREADY_ACCEPTED (409) via FOR UPDATE lock
• Platform fee: 3% (estimatedFare * 0.03) from your acceptRideRequest
• Stops: max 2 per ride (from createRideRequest code)
• Socket events: ride:accepted, ride:started, ride:completed
• KYC join: uses kyc table (not user_profiles) for rider/driver names

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
HOW TO USE THIS COLLECTION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════
1. Run '🔐 Login' section first to get tokens
2. Run sections in order: Setup → Ride Request → Bidding → Ride Lifecycle
3. IDs auto-chain via test scripts
4. Each section has NEGATIVE tests built in

item.name: Get Bids — No Active Bids (empty request)
✅ Step 7 — Rider Accepts Bid (Ride Created)
item.description:
acceptBid:
  1. Gets bid + ride_request details
  2. Creates ride row: INSERT INTO rides (...) VALUES (..., status='accepted')
  3. Updates bid: status='accepted', accepted_at=NOW()
  4. Updates ride_request: status='accepted', matched_driver_id, created_ride_id
  5. Rejects all other bids on same request
  6. Sends socket notification to driver via notifyBidAccepted(bid.driver_id, {...})

NOTE: Payment authorization happens in acceptRideRequest (fixed price path), NOT in acceptBid (bidding path).
If using bidding, payment auth happens when driver calls acceptRideRequest on the pre-created ride.

exec: console.log('🔔 Socket event sent to driver: bid:accepted');
console.log('Other bids on same request were automatically rejected');

item.name: 🚕 Step 7B — Fixed Price: Driver Accepts Directly
item.description:
For fixed_price rides (no bidding), driver calls acceptRideRequest directly.
This path DOES trigger payment authorization:
  1. Checks driver not already on active ride (DRIVER_ALREADY_ON_ACTIVE_RIDE)
  2. Locks ride_request row FOR UPDATE
  3. Checks status='pending' (REQUEST_ALREADY_ACCEPTED)
  4. Creates ride with estimated values copied from request
  5. Updates ride_request: matched_driver_id + created_ride_id
  6. Fetches rider's DEFAULT payment method
  7. Maps provider.type → paymentSource
  8. Calls RidePaymentService.authorizeRidePayment (funds → escrow)
  9. Platform fee: 3% of estimated fare
  10. Socket: emitToUser(riderId, 'ride:accepted', {...})

exec: console.log('💳 Payment authorized and locked in escrow');
console.log('🔔 Socket: ride:accepted emitted to rider');
if (j.message === 'DRIVER_ALREADY_ON_ACTIVE_RIDE') console.warn('Driver has active ride — complete it first');
if (j.message === 'REQUEST_ALREADY_ACCEPTED') console.warn('Request was already accepted by another driver');
if (j.message === 'DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_SET') console.warn('Rider has no default payment method set');

item.name: Driver Accepts — Already On Active Ride (should 409)
📋 Step 8 — Get Ride Details
item.description:
getRideDetails query JOINs:
  rides → ride_requests (via created_ride_id reverse link)
  rides → users/kyc/auth_credentials for rider
  rides → drivers/users/kyc/auth_credentials for driver
  drivers → vehicles for vehicle info
  ride_requests → ride_stops

Returns: names from KYC table, phone/email from auth_credentials, stops array

exec: console.log('Vehicle:', d.vehicle_type, d.vehicle_make, d.vehicle_model, d.vehicle_color, d.license_plate);

item.name: 🚗 Step 9 — Driver Starts Ride
item.description:
startRide:
  UPDATE rides SET status='started', started_at=NOW()
  WHERE id=$1 AND driver_id=$2 AND status='accepted'
  Then emits socket: ride:started to rider

exec: console.log('✅ Ride started | status:', d.status, '| started_at:', d.started_at);
console.log('🔔 Socket: ride:started emitted to rider:', d.rider_id);
pm.test('404 (already started, WHERE status=accepted finds nothing)', () => pm.expect([404,400]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: 🛑 Step 10 — Stop Management (Multi-Stop Rides)
item.description:
For rides with stops (max 2):
  arriveAtStop: UPDATE ride_stops SET actual_arrival_time=NOW(), status='arrived'
  departFromStop: UPDATE ride_stops SET actual_departure_time=NOW(), status='completed'

Both use stopId from ride_stops table.
Get stopId from GET /api/rides/:rideId response.data.stops[0].id

exec: console.log('✅ Arrived at stop:', j.data.address, '| arrival_time:', j.data.actual_arrival_time);
console.log('No stop found (use stopId from ride details)');
console.log('✅ Departed from stop | departure_time:', j.data.actual_departure_time, '| status:', j.data.status);
pm.test('Stop not found message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Stop not found'));

item.name: 🏁 Step 11 — Driver Completes Ride
item.description:
completeRide:
  UPDATE rides SET status='completed', completed_at=NOW()
  WHERE id=$1 AND driver_id=$2 AND status='started'
  Then: RidePaymentService.completeRidePayment(ride.id)
    → LedgerService.settlePayment (escrow → driver + platform)
    → Settlement record created (status=pending)
  Then: emitToUser(rider_id, 'ride:completed', {redirectTo: /rating/rideId})

exec: console.log('💰 Payment settled: escrow → driver + platform (3% fee)');
console.log('🔔 Socket: ride:completed emitted to rider → review form shown');
console.log('Final ride state:', d.status, '| completed_at:', d.completed_at);
console.log('Payment:', d.payment_status, '| Total:', d.total_amount, '| Platform fee:', d.platform_fee);
console.log('Driver ledger balance after settlement:', pm.response.json().data?.balance, 'NPR');

item.name: ❌ Step 11B — Cancel Ride (Alternative Path)
item.description:
cancelRide:
  UPDATE rides SET status='cancelled', cancelled_at=NOW()
  WHERE id=$1 AND (driver_id=$2 OR rider_id=$3) AND status IN ('accepted','started')

No payment refund triggered here — refund comes from:
  POST /api/wallet/ride-payments/:rideId/cancel
  which calls RidePaymentService.cancelRidePayment
  → escrow → original payment source

exec: console.log('⚠️ Payment refund NOT auto-triggered — call /wallet/ride-payments/:rideId/cancel separately');
console.log('Cannot cancel:', j.message, '(may be completed or wrong status)');
console.log('✅ Payment refunded | escrow → rider wallet');
